```{r bootstrap-weather-anova, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
# Bootstrap the ANOVA F-Statistic & Effect Sizes

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Parameters ----
B <- 1000
set.seed(2025)

# ---- Pre-allocate ----
boot <- tibble(
  F_value             = numeric(B),
  diff_Cloudy_Clear   = numeric(B),
  diff_Rain_Clear     = numeric(B),
  diff_SnowIce_Clear  = numeric(B)
)

# ---- Bootstrap loop ----
n <- nrow(df_grouped)
for (i in seq_len(B)) {
  # sample WITH replacement
  df_b <- df_grouped[sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE), ]
  
  # fit one-way ANOVA
  aov_b   <- aov(severity ~ weather_grp, data = df_b)
  ssum    <- summary(aov_b)[[1]]
  boot$F_value[i] <- ssum["weather_grp", "F value"]
  
  # extract Tukey diffs
  td <- TukeyHSD(aov_b)$weather_grp
  boot$diff_Cloudy_Clear[i]  <- td["Cloudy-Clear",  "diff"]
  boot$diff_Rain_Clear[i]    <- td["Rain-Clear",    "diff"]
  boot$diff_SnowIce_Clear[i] <- td["Snow/Ice-Clear","diff"]
}

# ---- Plot 1: F-statistic histogram ----
ggplot(boot, aes(F_value)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, fill = "#4C72B0", color = "white") +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distribution of ANOVA F-Statistic",
    x     = "F value for Weather Group",
    y     = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

# ---- Plot 2: Effect-size densities ----
boot_long <- boot %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("diff_"),
    names_to  = "contrast",
    values_to = "diff"
  )

ggplot(boot_long, aes(x = diff, fill = contrast)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  labs(
    title = "Bootstrap Distribution of Mean Severity Differences\n(versus Clear)",
    x     = "Mean Difference",
    y     = "Density",
    fill  = "Contrast"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)

```
